The '''''Valorum''''' was a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Confederation Fleet]]. It was originally commissioned during the final days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].<ref name="Fury" />

The ''Valorum'' was present during "negotiations" between the [[Second Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|second fleet]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and some of the oldest and most run-down units of the [[Confederation]] fleet, most of which were also commissioned during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As part of an elaborate ploy to kill [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and destroy a large segment of the Alliance fleet, the ''Valorum'' was sent to a deep space rendezvous with Solo's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']], to discuss terms for a surrender. In truth, the operation was simply an effort to bring Jacen Solo into the open and kill him using the recently operational [[Centerpoint Station]].

The Alliance fleet, led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]]/Joint Chief-of-State Jacen Solo, and the Confederation [[Decoy fleet|fleet]], led by the ''Valorum''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hoclaw]], engaged in a [[Battle of the rendezvous point|battle]]. Almost all of the ships on both sides were destroyed when Centerpoint Station was fired. While the ''Anakin Solo'' escaped, and most of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] managed to avoid the hypergravity blast, the ''Valorum'' and the other aged vessels were destroyed, as well as the [[Second Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Second Fleet]].
